name: World Wide Hospitality Furniture - Home Furniture Design, Rejuvenation Furniture & Restoration
old_description: NEW ITEMS FOR HOSPITALITY AND RESIDENTIAL PROPERTIES - CLICK HERE
about:
World Wide Hospitality Furniture operates from Kailua-Kona on the island of Hawaii. The company has been led by CEO Isaac Gonshor for 46 years, though a specific founding date is not publicly stated. Gonshor references a partner, Arnie, and a long-standing staff, suggesting a closely held operation, but the input does not specify a formal ownership designation such as family-owned or veteran-owned.

The business manufactures rattan furniture with a tropical aesthetic for both hospitality and residential markets. Production includes complete pieces — bedrooms, living rooms, dining, sectionals, and outdoor sets — as well as a parts and rejuvenation line for restoration. Customers select a frame, a stain finish, and a fabric through a three-step customization process. A showroom and inventory facility in Kona serves as a display and distribution point, though square footage and headcount are not disclosed.

Primary customers are vacation-property owners, condo developers, and hospitality operators furnishing tropical destinations. The company highlights recent 2024 hospitality projects and positions itself as a go-to supplier for vacation condos. Residential buyers seeking island-style furnishings also purchase directly.

Gonshor emphasizes that the firm is the actual manufacturer of every item it sells, a factor he ties to durability, longevity, and cost advantage. The tagline "Buy It For Life" reflects a stated commitment to long-lasting construction rather than disposable furniture.
